question: Are the top forward-prop candidate clusters genuine Band A/B multi-solution alternates or local-window false positives when rendered in hi-fi over the full trajectory?
hypothesis: The top s057h clusters are genuine multi-solution alternates (Band A/B) recoverable by back-propagating (q_a, omega) to (q0, omega0) and rendering hi-fi.
narrative_md: Architectural reframe: ALL 16 hi-fi-rendered candidates (top-15 clusters + truth cluster) are Band D; truth cluster rho=44.07. Smoke tests confirm the methodology (exact-truth render rho=0, truth back-prop rho=0.65 Band A). The killer is back-propagation amplification of the candidates' +15% |omega| error -- ~445deg accumulated rotation deviation over the 50-min rewind. The architecture finds LOCALLY consistent (q_a, omega) over the validator window, not full-trajectory inversions; candidates need LM polish. Renders truth cluster -- oracle-leak, N=1.
